global_leaf_reconciliation_rule.principle: count semantic effect leaves, preserve every historical/source provenance node, and never count the same mechanism twice
rules: Historical Release-1 IDs and text are immutable provenance and may never be renumbered or silently rewritten.
A SAME unit with no versioned effect children may count once when terminally fach-reviewed.
A PARTIAL_PARENT, OVERMERGED or TRUNCATED parent with versioned terminal children is provenance/nonleaf for effect counting; its countable effect children count individually.
An ABSENT effect-bearing passage restored with a stable additive ID counts once only at its final effect-leaf level; if represented by a parent plus children, the parent is nonleaf.

CONTEXT_ONLY, headings, transitions, historical achievement/baseline narration, and pure restatements without an independent future effect mechanism do not count as effect leaves, but remain in the source-coverage map.
Continuation fragments are relation edges unless they add a distinct independent mechanism; they must not become duplicate effect leaves merely because they cross a page/source boundary.

Stable source_unit_id is the first global dedupe key. If the same ID appears in multiple/overlapping shard versions, identical terminal payloads dedupe; conflicting terminal status/direction/evidence is a hard reconciliation blocker.
No object may be countable simultaneously as a nonleaf parent and as one of its countable children.
Every countable final effect leaf must have one terminal fach status: EDITORIAL_V2_PLUS_APPROVED, REVIEWED_NOT_ASSESSABLE_WITH_EXACT_REASON, or SOURCE_UNIT_RECLASSIFIED_VERSIONED.
No authoritative denominator is frozen while any expected canonical shard is unmaterialized, any restore/overmerge gap is unresolved, any duplicate conflict remains, or any final leaf is nonterminal.
authoritative_source_unit_count and authoritative_effect_mechanism_count are derived separately from explicit source_role/effect_role flags; equality must not be assumed or forced.
